reviews.text:
WORST EXPERIENCE EVER. I made an online appointment for a room-in visit at 11:30 AM. When I arrived exactly on time, the appointment was not honored. I was told that mornings were for drop-offs only and that I had to leave my cat there until at least 1:30 PM because the veterinarian was going to lunch at 12:00.
The photo shows the appointment details and the parking ticket showing the exact time I arrived. I made the trip specifically for the appointment I had scheduled, yet instead of acknowledging the scheduling error and finding a solution, they made me waste my time and unnecessarily stressed my cat.
Very disappointing experience and poor handling of the situation.

We’ve been going to the midtown Miami location for about 2 years. Love the staff and the way they treat my babies Coa and now Lola. Check in with Laz is a pleasure. Steve with my babies just  amazing. Always carding.
The doctor always calls with updates. And I feel they do care about my girls.
Couple of hiccups here and there but I’m very happy going there and will continue to go.
Daphne is very nice and her customer service was amazing thank you!!
Worst place ever, extremely rude staff
How is possible that the lady on the front desk yelled at me bc she needed to put me in a hold - after I wait on the line for over 15 min
Setting up an appointment was so easy and everyone there was so friendly and helpful, not to mention the Veterinarian well experienced in getting a diagnosis for my cat.
Thank you "fur" the review! 🐕 …

it’s literally ALWAYS something with them. i’ve put up with it for years just because there’s no other “wellness plan” out there. you just have to read through the reviews to get a good sense on what to expect. if you arrive on time (or earlier) for your appointment, they make you wait for at least 30 minutes. and don’t even get me started on pick up, which will also take them a good 30 min just to bring your dog out. if you are 10 min late, they will fight you over it being 15 min and now you’ve missed your appointment. the service is ALWAYS terrible, very unfortunate to have to deal with it.

Possibly the worst Banfield in the entire country. It’s definitely the worst of the four Banfields. We’ve been to across three states. They seem to rarely have medication in stock and when you ask them to approve medication request through chewy, you have to constantly call and pester them to approve the request.

I wish I could rate this location lower than one star. I had an extremely disappointing and unprofessional experience at this Banfield.

I scheduled an appointment online for a new pet I had just gotten, I tried calling before and got hung up on 3 times.when I arrived, I was told that there was no appointment in their system. Instead of trying to calmly resolve the situation, a supervisor who another employee referred to as “Mari” or “Mary” came out with an incredibly rude and dismissive attitude. She actually told us that if we did not want to bring our pet there, we could go somewhere else. That is an unacceptable way for someone in any position to speak to a client who simply came in expecting the appointment they scheduled.

What made the situation even more concerning was hearing from another PetSmart customer about a previous negative interaction involving this same supervisor, including an allegation that she had thrown medical instruments down in an exam room while upset. While I did not personally witness that incident, hearing that another customer had experienced similar behavior was very concerning after the interaction I had with her myself.

I also spoke with another woman who identified herself as a practice manager, and unfortunately, that interaction was no better. Communication was extremely difficult she did not know basic english or spanish, and she was rude and dismissive not only toward us, but in the way she interacted with other customers as well.

The entire location appeared disorganized, poorly managed, and lacking basic customer service and professionalism. When people are bringing in animals they care about, they should feel comfortable trusting the staff and management. Instead, this experience made me extremely uncomfortable bringing my pet here.

I sincerely hope someone in Banfield’s district or corporate leadership looks into the management and customer service at this location because the behavior we experienced was completely unacceptable.

I am very happy with Banfield in midtown Mia. Dr. Joy is very kind and knowledgeable. Brigit is super helpful at the front desk, as well. Everyone is doing their best. This is not a SPA but a pet hospital with people constantly working and being overwhelmed with work and just be kind to them. If you are kind and go with realistic expectations and don't act privileged, you'd loved the place. This is a hospital and NOT your SPA, treat this people with some respect.

Coming from another country, I wasn't very familiar with the rules and best practices of being a pet owner in the U.S. The team took the time to help me understand my needs, my options, and the associated costs. They were polite, friendly, and genuinely welcoming—a rare find around here! My dog felt very well taken care of, and so did I. 10 out of 10. I couldn't have asked for better service.
They dk pretty good work but they like to make you and your pet wait even if you have an appt.
Amazing vet! I totally recommend it, very professional doctors!!

i was ready to leave banfield hospital. but today my mini schnauzer fania was seen by the most kind loving and knowledgeable vet i have ever met in banfield midtown. her name is Dr. Tognozzi. i asked if she could always see fania my baby and she said of course! that’s the only reason why im staying

I've had ongoing issues with this Banfield location that make every visit a frustrating experience. On average, I wait at least 30 minutes to check in even when I have a scheduled appointment time. The online booking system doesn't seem to reflect actual in-person availability at all — after you book, they call you to "confirm" whether that time slot is actually real. It's a complete waste of time to book online if someone still has to call and verify it.

The communication here is abysmal. Most recently, my dog had a follow-up appointment for an infection, and the doctor never told me I needed to stop applying the ointment 3 days prior to the visit. So after waiting almost 30 minutes to check in, they informed me my dog couldn't even be seen — because of something they should have told me in the first place.

This is just one of several examples of poor communication and disorganization I've experienced here. I only continue coming here out of convenience, since there isn't a closer alternative. If there were, I'd be taking my business elsewhere.

Please don’t bring your animal here. They almost killed my cat by overdosing her on insulin. The doctor gave my cat the wrong syringe size and gave my cat too much insulin to the fact she had to be rushed to VEG ER. He called me to come take my cat to the ER but it wasn’t going to be in a timely manner so he did me a “favor” in his words by taking her there. He didn’t see remorseful and told me that “mistakes happen”! Really? You are a certified professional and showed negligence. If this were a human you could not use that excuse. I didn’t even get an apology for him almost killing my cat. Needless to say, my cat seems to be pulling through. Best thing I can say is they footed the ER bill because they are at fault. I should have went to Banfield in Miramar. I will absolutely will never recommend this place
Woof-tastic! Thank you for the 4-star rating for our pet hospital. Your feedback is like treats for us! We're eager to hear how we can make your pet's next visit tail-waggingly amazing.

Every time we bring our dog to Banfield is a frustrating experience. We schedule the appointments ahead, they call and text to confirm, we arrive on time and always have to wait about 40 minutes for the doctor. It’s also very common to have them reschedule appointments with a short notice. Careless about people’s time
Staff were very helpful and professional. I will be recommending This pet hospital

Just like everyone else in the reviews, I also had a horrible experience here. My cats were exposed to parvo and desperately needed to get a booster shot. On Monday, I took one cat, and everything went smoothly with the medical staff, but the front desk was definitely cold and unfriendly. The next day, I had the misfortune of having to speak with Bridget (who is mentioned in other reviews multiple times). She was so rude that it was shocking. I spoke with her on a Tuesday at 7:30 AM and she told me that they could only accommodate drop-off, and if I wanted to do in-room, I would have to wait until next week— 6 days later. I was so taken aback that I hung up the phone. I want nothing to do with this place. This is such a sensitive profession, and for them to be so callous in dealing with a vulnerable population is enraging. I hope Bridget feels deeply ashamed of herself. People come here already in stress, and she’s just out here making life difficult for people when they need help the most.

The staff there are mostly professional and friendly, from reception to the veterinary visit. Today, I had a problem with Dr. Tracy Scola, who was rude and unprofessional. She said my 6-month-old dog, who had surgery 15 days ago, was full of knots. I told her to check on her computer that Mar had just had surgery and that it was illogical for me to bring her in for grooming, which would also be her first time after surgery. She literally turned around and left without saying a word. I DON'T WANT TO IMAGINE HOW SHE TREATS THE OTHER ANIMALS IN THE BACK AND HER COLLEAGUES.

Same terrible customer service. After leaving them once and having to return because South Beach closed, nothing had changed. If convenience is what you need fine, if you don’t have the patience for incompetence go to another location!
Excellent service

I genuinely hate leaving negative reviews, especially for places I trust with my pets, but this experience at Banfield Midtown Miami was incredibly disappointing.

My dog Nala had an appointment scheduled for 05/13/26 at 9:00 AM. I received multiple confirmation texts, a confirmation voicemail, and even called back to confirm the appointment myself. When I arrived for the original appointment, I was told the appointment had somehow not been properly entered into the system and that I would need to come back the following day instead.

Although this was frustrating and inconvenient, I understood mistakes happen and agreed to rearrange my schedule to come back the next morning. I made it very clear to the employee helping me (Bridget C.) that I work and would have to move things around last minute in order to make it happen. She reassured me it would be fine and even told me she would be there all morning.

The next day, despite doing my best to rearrange my entire morning because of THEIR scheduling error, I arrived about 30 minutes late. Before I could even explain myself, Bridget immediately raised her voice at me in front of other customers. People in the lobby literally turned around because of how uncomfortable the interaction was.

I calmly explained that I had already communicated the scheduling conflict the day before and reminded her that I would not even have needed to come back had the original appointment not been mishandled. Instead of showing understanding or professionalism, the interaction continued with an unnecessarily rude attitude that honestly left me shocked.

Thankfully, the nurse and doctor on staff were kind, calm, and accommodating. They were able to squeeze Nala into the schedule, and I truly appreciate them for that. The medical staff themselves were wonderful.

However, customer service matters — especially at a place where people are trusting you with beloved family pets. After reading other reviews, I realized I’m clearly not the only person who has experienced issues with the front desk/customer service at this location.

The only reason I’ll continue using Banfield at all is because I’ve had consistently positive experiences at the Boca Raton location. If Midtown Miami were my only option, I would honestly rather pay out of pocket elsewhere than continue bringing my pets here.

I hope management takes these concerns seriously, because the doctors and nurses deserve a front desk experience that reflects the same level of care and professionalism they provide.
Horrible customer service.

I’ve been taking my dog there for about three years now and a lot of the time I feel a lack of warmth or lack of care from the staff members there. They seem to also forget the things that I’ve told them about my dog even though they have notes in their system.  My dog has had to go to an Emergency vet office a couple times over the years and Id prefer to take him there if it wasn’t an emergency setting. They are sweet to my dog and seem like they actually give a damn about their patients and what they do. Some of the procedures done there cost me way less without “insurance” than with having my animal insured with Banfield. Banfield has a bad reputation with the indifference and lack of attention the staff members seem to have towards the animal. That doesn’t apply to every staff member there, there are definitely gems working there like Kira at the front desk.
Last time I had my dog there they kept him there all day because of a teeth cleaning. When I came to pick him up, as we were leaving the desk—not even a few steps from away— he peed like he had never peed before and then proceeded to poop two different times before even leaving the building. I was stuck cleaning the mess, which I have no problem cleaning up after my dog but I could tell no one took him out to go to the bathroom… not one time. They saw me dealing with that and said nothing and did not offer assistance. I will be looking for services elsewhere.
You've got us purring with your rating! 😸 Thank you for choosing Banfield. …
Friendly, helpful staff. Excellent pet services.
The love JhonZito, the best
Thanks for the pawsitive review!
Hi there - A big thank you for your pawsome review! 🐾 We hope to see you again soon. …

Scheduled appointment for 9:30am.  Called day of to be told had to come at 10:45.  Came at 10:45 not in person no drop off.  As of 11:20am still can’t drop off or be seen.  Why have a reservation system?

Very disappointed about this facility!! We got an appointment to get an International travel certificate to travel to Italy, normally we go to Coral Gables location but there was no Doctor qualified to get the certificate!!! We asked about the price and were told $400-600!!!!!! This is outrageous!!! You have your dog enrolled in wellness program and you are charged this amount of money!!!!!!  Of course we had to find a more affordable  office
If you have an aggressive dog, go with Mr. Hector Joy, he is the best !!!
Hi Verneta - It was a pleasure caring for your furry friend. Thanks for the great rating! Please let us know if you have any suggestions on how we can make your next experience with us even better.
The front desk lady here is so rude. They can never get my dogs in, even for an emergency. Will be cancelling Banfield plan.

I had an appointment for my dog, Mora, at 4:30 PM. I called ahead to let them know I was running about 5–6 minutes late and was told it was okay as long as I arrived by 4:35. I arrived at 4:36 and checked in immediately, confirming I was there for the 4:30 appointment.

I explained multiple times that my time was very limited and that I needed to leave before 5:00 PM to pick up my children from school. I requested a quick follow-up visit, since this was just to check on Mora after her last appointment and to purchase her medication.

I was placed in a room and repeatedly reassured that a doctor would see me soon. However, I waited over 20 minutes without anyone coming in. During that time, I could hear staff and doctors in the back chatting and laughing, while no one attended to my appointment. There were no other patients in the room area.

At 5:01 PM, I had no choice but to leave. I told the staff not to get the doctor anymore because I could not stay, and asked only to be sold the medication and reschedule. This situation is especially frustrating because this has happened before, where visits are marked in the system as “completed” even when Mora was not actually seen.

I completely understand that veterinary offices get busy, but when appointments are scheduled, clients’ time should be respected—especially when we clearly communicate constraints. Unfortunately, this office repeatedly fails at that, and it makes it very difficult to trust their scheduling and follow-through.
You've got us purring with your rating!  Thank you for choosing Banfield.

This has been a completely awful experience.

My dog has visible head swelling, which is clearly an urgent medical issue. I had an appointment scheduled today at 10:00 a.m. Yesterday, Banfield called me to reschedule because the doctor supposedly wouldn’t be available. I adjusted my entire schedule and moved the appointment to 11:00 a.m. as they suggested.

I arrived on time for the 11:00 a.m. appointment and was then made to wait 40 minutes, only for staff to tell me that the doctor at this location was in surgeries and my dog would not be seen at all today.

So let me be clear:
They gave me an appointment, moved it themselves, had me come in, made me wait, and then told me they couldn’t see my dog.

At that point, they told me to drive to another location 30 minutes away, which is completely unrealistic when my entire day was already planned around the appointment they scheduled. If I had known this earlier, I would have taken my dog to another veterinarian where she would have actually received care.

I am paying $60 a month for a wellness plan, and yet when my dog actually needs medical attention, Banfield shows zero consideration for my time, my schedule, or my dog’s health. Emergencies should be handled with urgency and transparency—not poor communication and wasted time.

This experience cost me time, money, and emotional energy, and worst of all, my dog still did not receive the care she needs. Completely unacceptable.

Awful customer service. Aren’t these people supposed to be professionals? I don’t understand why employees think it’s acceptable to shrug or make faces when a client is asking questions or voicing concerns. This is supposed to be a helpful, reassuring experience for both pets and their owners.

On Jan 23rd around 2:15PM, I had a really rude interaction with a woman who wasn’t even the veterinarian. She sat at her desk listing off a bunch of tests and expensive procedures I “needed” to do without ever seeing my cat or even knowing what he looked like. She was so unhelpful, uninterested...it just left me with such a bad feeling. Every time I asked a question, she shrugged or looked at me like I was stupid.
I actually care about my pet, and I don’t appreciate a money-grabbing business taking advantage of that worry and vulnerability. Completely unprofessional experience. I’ll be taking my money elsewhere.

*****Edit (the very next day): I went to Adam’s Veterinary Clinic on 79th Street, and the difference was night and day. It’s honestly amazing how far basic compassion and professionalism can go.
Dr. Lexy was absolutely amazing! She actually came into the room, met my cat Asher, listened to my concerns, and answered all of my questions without rushing or talking down to me. She was polite, funny, and it was enlightening to understand my cats condition. Instead of immediately pushing thousands of dollars in tests, she explained what might be going on and walked me through a process of elimination.
I walked out paying under $200 and feeling informed and reassured instead of stressed and taken advantage of. If you want actual compassion and to spend way less money, go here instead.

I am writing this review because of a very serious and stressful experience I had with Banfield that almost prevented my dogs from returning to the United States.

I took my dogs from the U.S. to Colombia, and before traveling I went to Banfield to request the required health certificate. I was very clear that this certificate needed to include both the exit AND the re-entry rabies documentation so my dogs could return to the United States. Banfield knew this from the beginning I told Doctor Joy and team.

However, they only provided the exit certificate, not the re-entry rabies certificate. At no point that day did anyone tell me that my dogs supposedly could not receive that certificate because their rabies vaccines were administered at another veterinary clinic. This was never explained to me before I paid for the service.

I only found out about this issue later, when I went back to the doctor’s counter and was told that was the reason. By that time, my dogs were already abroad. As a result of Banfield’s negligence and lack of transparency, my dogs were almost denied entry back into the United States from Colombia, which caused me extreme stress and fear.

To make matters worse, I called Banfield on December 26 seeking urgent help and solutions, and no one answered kindly or offered any real assistance to help me bring my dogs back to the U.S.

If Banfield cannot issue rabies certificates for dogs vaccinated elsewhere, they should have told me that clearly on the day of my visit, before charging me. Failing to do so is taking advantage of a client, is completely unprofessional, and is not being honest or transparent. Had they told me the truth, I would have gone to another veterinarian immediately.

This experience showed a serious lack of responsibility, communication, and ethics. When it comes to international travel and pets’ lives, mistakes like this are unacceptable.

I would not recommend Banfield to anyone who needs accurate documentation or trustworthy guidance—especially for international travel.

I previously contacted the customer service email they provide, and I never received a response. This is very disrespectful to customers. On top of that, I was charged for a service that was never provided, and when I tried to resolve the issue, they completely ignored me. Very poor customer service.
Perfect clinic! 100 % recommended

Your review has brightened our day! We're happy to see that you and your pet had a positive experience with us. We're always looking to grow and improve, so please share any ideas on how we can make your next visit even more enjoyable.

Banfield lost a confirmed follow-up appointment for my dog after an emergency IVDD diagnosis and then refused to provide any in-room doctor care. (Read more below.)

My 13-year-old dog was diagnosed at an emergency hospital with Intervertebral Disc Disease (IVDD) after being in severe pain and neurological distress. This is a serious spinal condition that requires careful follow-up and ongoing medical management. I scheduled an in-room appointment with Banfield for 8:30 AM, received a confirmation email, and arrived on time specifically to review her ER records, X-rays, medications, and recovery plan with a veterinarian.

When I arrived, I was told that my confirmed appointment “did not exist” in their system. The only option offered was a drop-off, which was completely inappropriate for a neurological case where direct communication with a doctor is essential. I was then told the next available in-room appointment would not be for more than a week.

Because Banfield could not honor a confirmed appointment or provide any physician communication after losing it, I was forced to call the emergency hospital that treated her just to obtain medication refills and guidance. The ER was able to help immediately — which highlights how unacceptable this situation was.

This was not a routine visit. This was medically necessary follow-up after a spinal emergency. Losing a confirmed appointment and offering no meaningful alternative is dangerous, not just inconvenient.

If your pet has a serious or time-sensitive condition, I would not trust this location to provide reliable care or continuity.

🚫 Banfield Midtown Miami = chaos on repeat 🐾. Every in-room appointment I’ve booked is a disaster. Confirmed via app and email? Irrelevant. They’ll call last minute with a new, ridiculous excuse. “Vet only sees dogs under 10 lbs.” “Drop-off only”—despite never booking drop-off. Double-booked appointments. Emails showing the wrong info. I fix it online. This morning? “No in-room visits for five days”—even though the app says otherwise. Closest location closed after I signed up for wellness plans. If they can’t manage scheduling, don’t offer in-room visits. Disorganized, disrespectful, infuriating—take your pets anywhere else 🐶❌

I called this morning and asked if a doctor can see my dog because she has chocked this morning and I wanted to make sure that everything was OK with her somebody name Bridget told me to bring her at 1 PM. I got there at 1:05. Nobody was in the front. There was five other people waiting so when I finally came to my turn the lady in the front told me that my appointment had passed because it had been more than 30 minutes even though I had been waiting there, it’s very unprofessional very rude and they don’t care about other peoples time!

Seems that scheduling is the tune of the music, scheduled a week in advance for an appointment, they call me less than 24 hours before the scheduled appointment to notify me I would have to drop my puppy off for 4 hours like it’s some kind of twisted daycare, I have a French bulldog puppy and I will be damned if I leave my baby alone with other dogs and people I don’t know, I am recovering from a broken leg so trying to even make arrangements for this appointment was a miracle, I signed up for the wellness package, I’m having 2nd thoughts, it is deplorable that yall are operating like this, like I would leave my puppy that costs as much as a car who is just 4 months old alone with other dogs whom I do not know their health history or vaccination status or temperament? I am beyond pissed

If Zero stars existed you would deserve them!
Banfield Midtown has been the worst veterinary experience I’ve ever had. From the front desk staff « Diedrich Ramirez » to the veterinarian’s lack of follow-through « Dr Mejias », this clinic showed a complete lack of professionalism and compassion.
I brought my dog in for a consultation regarding a skin condition and paid $300  which is already overpriced , I was given a 15 ml topical antibiotic and told he would be fine after 10 days. The medication ran out in less than 5 days, and the irritation worsened and spread. I called repeatedly to request a refill or speak with the vet and was met with constant excuses: she was with another patient, in surgery, on break, would call back, and eventually that she was on vacation for a week.
When I asked if another veterinarian could help with the refill, I was told they “couldn’t” because it would put their medical license at risk.
After waiting for the vet to return, I was promised a callback or refill to be sent but that never happened.
Instead, I was told she could only help if I booked a same-day appointment and paid for another visit, so suddenly she was available if more money was involved.
During the calling process, Dietrich Ramirez repeatedly put me on hold for 15–20 minutes and provided no assistance. When I went to the clinic in person, his behavior was condescending, rude, and argumentativei couldn’t believe myself!
He showed no empathy or professionalism while handling a concerned pet owner and a sick animal, and he told me I have to wait until the clinic is about to close and all appointments are completed before he can get me the help I needed!
Only after another female front desk employee intervened and inquired what was I looking form, she walked to the back and returned with the refill in under two minutes. The issue I had was never complicated or demanding, it simply required someone willing to care, but my dog had to suffer a week longer due the clinic ‘s lack of compassion, accountability, and basic customer service training. My dog will never receive care at any Banfield location again. He is due for upcoming vaccinations, and we will be taking our business elsewhere.
And Diedrich you deserve to be fired

I had a very disappointing experience at Banfield in Midtown with my 11-year-old dog. The veterinarian prescribed what was presented to me as a medication to “reduce liver inflammation,” but it turned out to be just a supplement — the exact same supplement I was already giving my dog. I bought it trusting their recommendation, only to later discover it sells on Amazon for half the price.

They also prescribed eye drops that are over-the-counter and again cost half as much online, yet they were sold to me as if they required a veterinary prescription.

What concerned me the most was that the vet prescribed 42 antibiotic pills, to be given every 12 hours, without confirming whether my dog had any bacteria or infection. I was told, “Just give them to her just in case.” My veterinarian in Colombia immediately advised me not to give antibiotics without proof of infection, as this can seriously affect an older dog’s organs.

When I returned the next day asking for a refund, I was told, “We don’t take medications back.” I explained that the product was a vitamin supplement, not a medication, and the answer was simply, “Oh no, sorry,” with no willingness to help or even acknowledge the mistake.

Overall, it is clear to me that this place is more interested in pushing products and unnecessary treatments than actually caring for the pets they’re supposed to help. I will not be returning, and I hope other pet owners do their research before trusting this location with their animals’ health.

This place deserves negative stars.  We had scheduled a vet. appt. for both of our puppies to get their Bordetella vaccines/shots.  We scheduled an in-person appt. to see a vet. only to be called the following day saying it would be a “drop off.”  We arrived early and waited 15-20 minutes past our appt. time to be seen.  We have been waiting for over 4 hours now and they still haven’t given either of our puppies their shots.  They have been sitting in a cage the entire time.  Each time I check I’m told it should only be a few more minutes.  This place is more concerned with making a buck than a pet’s care and wellbeing.  We have been Banfield clients for several years but this will be the LAST time.
very professional vet and nurse.  very happy with service

Dedrick or something like that. 8am drop off. Worst customer service I’ve ever experienced at a vet. The process is painfully slow, they take forever to attend to you, even if you have an appointment. The whole experience feels more like sitting through a sales pitch than visiting a clinic.

I left this Banfield location feeling completely unheard and disappointed. I had an appointment, arrived on time, and still waited endlessly while others went ahead of me. No one took the time to explain what was happening, and when I tried to voice my concern, I was met with indifference.

It wasn’t just the delay, it was the feeling that my pets and I didn’t matter. I expected care and professionalism, especially for a first visit, but instead I left frustrated. I hope management reads this and start respecting the pet owners’ time.
Woof-tastic! Thank you for the rating for our pet hospital. Your feedback is like treats for us! We're eager to make your pet's next visit just as tail-waggingly amazing.
Thanks for the 5 stars and for partnering with us for your pet’s health!

Pathetic service 3 times I had got in room appointment but you do not offer what ypu have in your app The you scheduled getting there change and say no in room please drop off. 3 times 3 days 3 times loosing my time. i work to paid your $90 monlty so…….. Where is the customer care?

This clinic provides terrible care. Twice, in the same week, I scheduled an appointment for my pets and they called the day before saying that the schedule was no longer available. Rude attendant. I have never been and will not go to this place.
My dog feels very comfortable during her vet visits!
Dr.Mejias/Dr.joy both are  amazing doctors. All the nurse staff very attentive and receptionist kira and the gentleman were very kind !
A big thank you for your pawsome review! 🐾 We hope to see you again soon. …

I took my cat there because she hadn't eaten for a few days, and for a misdiagnosis, I had to pay $1,700, which is a rip-off. At another veterinary clinic, where I later went, they treated her perfectly for $279. Stay away from this place.

Banfield Vet Hospital, North Haven, CT is not only a great location, but the staff is AMAZING... My fur babies are kindly treated every visit. ALL STAFF is the best of the best Dr Cardona is not only professional but lovely person, and also thanks for your kindness, smiles, understanding, attention, support... Among them cheers to Jordyn, Laura, Brie, Devine, Maria, Nicole and Terea... Really love you all... Kisses from Nina and Manolito.

We had an appointment at 7:45 am and by 8:30am we were still waiting, One hour after they took my dog in. Our dog is anxious, and instead of showing empathy or offering solutions, the staff blamed us for not giving him a sedative beforehand. If they are the “professionals,” they should know how to handle all types of pets.

On top of that, the man with glasses at the front desk was extremely rude and dismissive. When we asked about the delay, he told us that if we didn’t want to wait, we could just leave. Completely unacceptable.

My dog was suffering in the waiting area while staff showed no concern. This clinic clearly does not put the wellbeing of animals or respect for clients first. I will never come back and I do not recommend this place to anyone. This place and the front desk staff SUCKS!
Very attentive and answered every question and got the opportunity to meet my puppies new vet before her first appointment!!

I arrived for an appointment today and was told that there was no record of any appointment for my dog today.  I confirmed via text 2 days ago and by phone yesterday.  Yet, they claim that my dog never had an appointment.

We’ve been paying for a Banfield wellness plan for 11 years —almost $10,000 in fees—and our dog has been healthy but when he was urgently sick, Banfield Midtown failed us. We called three times on Friday t bring him in for an urgent visit, were promised a call back, were encouraged that he would be squeezed in, and then when we didn't hear back we left a voicemail message after hours—no response.  Only after calling the next day and insisting on speaking with a supervisor were we finally able to bring him in. Banfield constantly calls to upsell services, but when our pet actually needed urgent care, they didn’t deliver. The vet did a thorough evaluation and we found out he has a serious heart issue and we will need to deal with it.  So, no complaint on the actual vet service.  But the management, support and follow-up from the staff that we received was not acceptable and needs to be addressed by Banfield corporate.
